objections.b_objection: A says training OVER 25 minutes; original says APPROXIMATELY 25 minutes. It trained individual task to 90% each then full task without ambiguous to 80% each condition. Correct duration and retain training criteria.
objections.source_local_adjacent_negative_or_altern: The source presents 25 min as an approximate duration and performance criteria as conjunctive.

objections.exact_original_pdf_locator: p15 Fig7 caption and panels A-F
objections.b_objection: A narrows 10x sigma scaling to trajectories only; caption states individualized sigma parameters were scaled by factor 10 for easier visualization of Fig7 potential landscapes and path displays. Do not narrow to trajectories alone.
objections.source_local_adjacent_negative_or_altern: Panels A-F show potential landscapes, dominant paths and height profiles, not only trajectories.

objections.exact_original_pdf_locator: p20 text immediately after Table3 and Fig9
objections.b_objection: Separate individual-parameter nonsignificant r and p values explicitly refer to left middle frontal gyrus cluster eigenvariate; do not generalize these separate null correlations to thalamostriatal ROI or every brain activation.
objections.source_local_adjacent_negative_or_altern: Source reports three different r/p values for the MFG only, whereas minimal action reports both MFG whole-brain and thalamostriatal ROI evidence.

objections.exact_original_pdf_locator: p40 model-derived rule-regressor GLM vs p41 independent second switch-minus-distractor GLM
objections.b_objection: A describes ambiguous each-trial regressors without specifying this is first model-derived rule regressor GLM; second contrast GLM has two condition-type ambiguous regressors (switched vs stayed) plus error trials and implicit baseline. Two analyses must remain typed and not conflated.
objections.source_local_adjacent_negative_or_altern: First GLM uses separate regressors for each ambiguous trial; second uses TWO aggregated ambiguous-category regressors and baseline as implicit.

objections.exact_original_pdf_locator: p34 Simulation of Behavioral Data and p7 Fig3F
objections.b_objection: A threshold mechanism omits specified numerical 10 Hz projection threshold, which is source-defined actual decision/readout. Add as method-bound exactly 10 Hz not a universal choice threshold.
objections.source_local_adjacent_negative_or_altern: Source says projected four alternatives assessed against 10 Hz and sensitivity only far from spontaneous state.

objections.exact_original_pdf_locator: p39 Estimation of the Minimal Action and p15 Fig7
objections.b_objection: A action construct omits the actual one-way parity-rule1 to magnitude-rule2 path, choice E_eff=-V(S_min), 50 line elements, 10^5 variance-in-segment-length penalty, Matlab fminunc, and asymmetry possible in reverse path. Add only method-specified algorithm, no numeric replication claim.
objections.source_local_adjacent_negative_or_altern: Source illustrates both directional paths in Fig7 but reports fitted minimal action used for participant analysis as rule1-to-rule2; regularity penalty and longest kinetic time are algorithmic choices.

objections.exact_original_pdf_locator: pp35-37 Bayesian posterior and MAP methods
objections.b_objection: A MCMC account omits 50,000 discarded steps from EACH 1 million-step chain, Gaussian MH proposal std 0.01 and locally adaptive KDE MAP extraction. Some param priors are Gaussian regularizers; no new out-of-sample claim.
objections.source_local_adjacent_negative_or_altern: Source explicitly states proposal sigma_MH, 2 chains x 1M, each 50k burn and local adaptive KDE.

objections.exact_original_pdf_locator: p17 physiological parameter results and Fig8, p18
objections.b_objection: A gives nondirectional basin dependence. Record sNMDA stabilizes high-rule basin; sGABA increases spontaneous basin and destabilizes high; sigma_rule smoothes basins and increases transitions. This source-specific distinction is load-bearing for attributed mechanism.
objections.source_local_adjacent_negative_or_altern: Nearby behavioral correlation trend at p=0.04 in Table2 did NOT survive multiple-comparison correction; do not call behavior-confirmed.

objections.b_objection: A states at least three baseline between critical but original task specifies pseudo-randomized MIN 3 MAX 6 baseline trials between critical including ambiguous. Add max 6 and keep ambiguous experimental vs explicit simulation separate.
objections.source_local_adjacent_negative_or_altern: The source states both a minimum of three after every critical and max six for all critical experimental types.

objections.exact_original_pdf_locator: pp18-20 Fig9 Table3 and p41 model-independent fMRI contrast GLM
objections.b_objection: A states generic thalamocorticostriatal BOLD association, not the separate corrected scopes: left MFG at whole-brain FWE-corrected cluster threshold vs bilateral thalamus/caudate search ROI threshold. Do not misstate ROI as whole-brain.
objections.source_local_adjacent_negative_or_altern: Fig9A/MFG uses whole-brain corrected threshold; Fig9B thalamostriatal uses anatomically restricted ROI correction.

objections.exact_original_pdf_locator: p17-18 Table2 and immediate adjacent narrative
objections.b_objection: Original tests correlations of model attractor depth with observed reaction times/error rates; no behavioral association survives multiple-comparison correction despite uncorrected switch RT cost p=0.04 and descriptive error trends. A includes p20 neuronal individual-param null but not this distinct behavioral negative result.
objections.source_local_adjacent_negative_or_altern: Do not interpret the raw p=0.04 as corrected significance or infer that attractor depth was validated by task-error/RT correlation.

objections.exact_original_pdf_locator: pp37-38 equation9 and discrete FP methods
objections.b_objection: Original approximates stationary OU noise by white diffusion and obtains generalized stationary probability on a rectangular rule-gating grid with zero-probability boundary and BTCS implicit finite differences, Matlab sparse linear-algebra time propagation to stationary density. A26/A37 carry concept but omit algorithm.
objections.source_local_adjacent_negative_or_altern: Equation9 is stationarity-conditioned diffusion approximation, not exact colored OU transient equality; preserve A37 already-bound exception, avoid duplicate caveat.
